previous_run.reason: The previous 55-run batch predates the collision-safe task identity and mandatory persistent Skill preload audit.
previous_run.known_environment_mismatch: location-data-to-d3 reused the Flink Docker environment because every prepared task had the basename task.
previous_run.skill_evidence_gap: Several previous rollouts did not contain executor-level proof that the repaired SKILL.md bodies were preloaded.

environment.strategy: Each rollout stages the task under a basename bound to task_id, experiment_id, and the complete task-tree hash. The Dockerfile hash and staged/source equality are recorded in EXECUTION_PREFLIGHT.json.

skill_exposure.strategy: The complete Skill bundle is snapshotted and hashed. A run is accepted only when executor metadata and the terminal trajectory outcome independently report the same bundle SHA256, Skill count, file list, and persistent-context preload state.

acceptance_policy.rule: Old attempts without EXECUTION_AUDIT.json valid=true are never reused and cannot enter a newly built 55-experiment manifest.

rerun.infrastructure_remediation: Transient Debian/Ubuntu download failures and the legacy Google Auto CA bootstrap were handled only in per-attempt staging Dockerfiles; task bodies, Skill bundles, and verifiers were not changed.
